newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Jollibee lowers 97 net growth target.
newsitem.headline: Jollibee lowers 97 net growth target.

text.p: The Philippines' fast food leader, Jollibee Foods Corp, said on Monday it expects 1997 net income to grow by 10 percent rather than the 20 percent originally projected.

"We will downgrade our net income projection because our operating costs relative to marketing and labour costs were not matched by a price increase," Jollibee vice-president for finance Raffy dela Rosa told Reuters by phone.
Asked whether the company would raise prices, Dela Rosa said: "There are no definite plans to increase prices as of today."
Jollibee earlier reported that its net profit in 1996 reached 603 million pesos.
